open_issues.impact: an operator can be asked to confirm a grant with a past expiry
open_issues.next: optional: pre-validate expiry in the route
open_issues.text: The grant confirm token is bound to plugin, capability, project, expiry and the manifest digest shown (PI6 at HTTP level); the route pre-validates capability (declared, not read/terminal, extension only) and project before asking for a confirmation, but an expiry in the past is refused only after the confirmation.

open_issues.impact: Disable can return with an invoke run still finishing
open_issues.text: Broker.cancel cannot cancel invoke-kind runs (no process), so Disable only waits the drain and grace time for them; argv runs with supports cancel (or system cancel) are cancelled.

For the next piece (P5.3): frontend/src/contracts/index.ts and app/compat.ts do not yet export or require plugin-api; /v1/plugins/{id} without project_id returns only every-project grants, so the UI must pass project_id to see project grants; disable returns 428 with details.confirm when runs are active; action_result has drained and cancelled counts. P5.4: tests/plugin_support.py builds a throwaway extension (queries, an invoke command with network effect, an argv sleeper with cancel) with a mode file (ok, garbage, domain, badview) and registers it in [aicore.plugins]; reuse it for E2E.
